title: Monitoring with Azure Monitor

header.html: Interpret metrics in Azure Monitor; configure log settings in Azure Monitor; query and analyze logs in Azure Monitor; set up alert rules, action groups and alert processing rules; configure and interpret monitoring of virtual machines, storage accounts and networks by using Azure Monitor Insights; use Azure Network Watcher and Connection Monitor
the official Microsoft Learn AZ-104 study guide, skills measured as of October 26, 2023

html:
1Azure Monitor at a glance

Azure Monitor collects, analyzes and acts on telemetry from Azure and other environments.

Data type What it is Stored
Metrics Numeric time series (CPU %, bytes in) Azure Monitor metrics database, near real time, kept 93 days
Logs Records and events with fields Log Analytics workspace, queried with KQL
Activity log Subscription-level control-plane events (who created, changed or deleted what) Kept 90 days; send it to a workspace for longer

2Metrics

Metrics Explorer charts metrics, lets you split by dimension (for example per instance), apply aggregation (average, max, count) and pin to dashboards. Platform metrics are collected automatically; guest OS metrics need an agent.

3Logs and diagnostic settings

Resource logs are not collected by default. A diagnostic setting on a resource sends platform logs and metrics to a destination:

Destination For
Log Analytics workspace Query and alert with KQL
Storage account Cheap long-term archive
Event Hub Stream to external tools

A Log Analytics workspace is queried in Logs with Kusto Query Language (KQL), for example:

AzureActivity | where OperationNameValue contains "delete" | project TimeGenerated, Caller, ResourceGroup

Exam tip

. "Resource logs are missing" = create a diagnostic setting. "Query across logs with a language" = Log Analytics and KQL.

4Alerts

Item Meaning
Alert rule Scope (resources) + condition (metric threshold, log query result, activity log event) + action group
Alert types Metric, log search, activity log
Action group What happens: email, SMS, push, voice, webhook, Logic App, Azure Function, runbook
Alert processing rule Modify alerts after they fire: suppress notifications (for example during maintenance windows) or add action groups
Severity 0 (critical) to 4 (verbose)

Exam tip

. "Stop alert emails during planned maintenance without deleting the rules" = an alert processing rule that suppresses notifications.

5Insights and Network Watcher

Tool Purpose
VM insights Performance and dependency map of VMs (needs the Azure Monitor Agent)
Storage insights Capacity, latency, availability across storage accounts
Network insights Topology and health of network resources
Network Watcher IP flow verify, next hop, connection troubleshoot, packet capture, NSG flow logs, topology
Connection Monitor Continuously tests connectivity and latency between endpoints and alerts on failures
Exam tip

. Resource logs are not collected until you create a diagnostic setting. Metrics are collected automatically.

6Exam Q&A

6.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1An administrator needs to know who deleted a virtual machine. Where should they look?

  • AMetrics Explorer
  • BThe Activity log
  • CAzure Advisor
  • DCost analysis
Show the answer

Answer: B. The Activity log records control-plane operations such as deletions.

S2A storage account's resource logs must be queried with KQL. What must be configured?

  • AA resource lock on the storage account so that its logs cannot be deleted
  • BA budget with alerts so that logging costs are reported each month
  • CA tag on the storage account that marks its logs for later queries
  • DA diagnostic setting sending logs to a Log Analytics workspace
Show the answer

Answer: D. Diagnostic settings route resource logs to a destination.

S3An alert must email the on-call team when CPU exceeds 80 percent. What should be created?

  • AAn Azure Policy assignment that audits the CPU usage of every VM
  • BA snapshot of each VM disk taken whenever the CPU stays high
  • CA dynamic group that contains all the VMs with high CPU usage
  • DA metric alert rule with an action group
Show the answer

Answer: D. Metric alert rules trigger action groups.

S4Notifications must be suppressed during a maintenance window without deleting alert rules. What fits?

  • ADeleting the action group
  • BA lock
  • CAn alert processing rule
  • DA tag
Show the answer

Answer: C. Processing rules can suppress notifications on a schedule.

S5Which tool continuously tests connectivity and latency between two endpoints?

  • AConnection Monitor
  • BAzure Advisor
  • CSoft delete
  • DCost alerts
Show the answer

Answer: A. Connection Monitor performs ongoing connectivity tests.

S6How long does the Activity log keep events by default?

  • A7 days
  • B1 year
  • C90 days
  • DForever
Show the answer

Answer: C. The Activity log is retained for 90 days.

6.2 Recall questions

R1What language queries Log Analytics?

Show the answer

Kusto Query Language (KQL).

R2How long are platform metrics kept?

Show the answer

93 days.

R3What does an action group define?

Show the answer

What happens when an alert fires (notifications and actions).

R4Name two diagnostic setting destinations.

Show the answer

For example a Log Analytics workspace and a storage account.

R5Name three alert rule types.

Show the answer

Metric, log search and activity log.

R6Which feature gives a dependency map of VMs?

Show the answer

VM insights.

7Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Data metrics (93 days), logs (workspace, KQL), Activity log (90 days)
Diagnostic settings send resource logs to workspace, storage, Event Hub
Alerts rule = scope + condition + action group; processing rules suppress or add actions
Insights VM, Storage, Network; Network Watcher; Connection Monitor
